title: Akiyama Mizuki — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I think I will too. K and Yuki already left.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Your birthday is in two weeks, right?
You should think about what you want to do.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If you can't think of anything, let me know. Okay, goodnight...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What I want to do for my birthday...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We had so many customers at work today.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm glad they all liked the style advice I gave them. That new line of pajamas is coming in soon too, so our customers will be able to look cute day and night.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Did I just get a message?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Mizuki, have you been thinking about what to do for your birthday?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yikes, I totally forgot! Hold on, why does Mafuyu know about—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Ena told me to ask you that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um...
<Sorry, I'm still thinking! Give me a little more time!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Phew... That reminds me, Ena said to tell her if I couldn't think of anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But... I'm pretty content just making music with the others.)

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: C'mon, let's get a move on! We might miss the shoot!

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: I know, I know! But, is MMJ seriously there?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna put my birthday on the back burner till I get home and be a lil' nosy first♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, over there. There's a crowd gathered!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: I'm afraid we'll be using this spot to shoot Hide & Street as part of Quiz Super 7.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I know that quiz! Celebrities hide on the street and people have to find them. It's super fun!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And if I remember right, Hide & Street is...)

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Those wishing to watch the shoot should please stand over here. If you are just passing through, please follow the instructions of my colleagues.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Now that I remember, they sometimes let passersby gather and watch so the celebrities can hide in their midst.)

rows.Speaker: Assistant Director
rows.Line: Thank you for joining us today, Momoi and Hinomori. We'll start filming in a short while, so please wait here for now.

rows.Speaker: Onlookers
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
It's the one and only Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Eep!
They look so cute! This is the best!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hehehe, it's fun to act the stan.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder where Haruka and Minori are... Maybe they're being filmed at a different spot?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Knowing idols personally kinda makes me feel like an anime protagonist.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Well, I just happened to meet them through Ena.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hm... Another message. Don't tell me it's Kanade nagging me this time...)

rows.Speaker: Airi's Message
rows.Line: <I thought I heard your voice, and I was right!>

rows.Speaker: Airi's Message
rows.Line: <By the way, isn't it your birthday soon? Shizuku and I have a special something for you♪>

rows.Speaker: Onlookers
rows.Line: My heart just stopped! Why did they do that all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Onlookers
rows.Line: It doesn't matter! That was amazing fan service! Thank you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I think they said it'll air next month.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't believe I even got some special fan service!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So you were practicing and spotted the shoot?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I saw Haruka and Minori in the distance, but when I went to say hi, they were surrounded by people and there were cameras on them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We'd missed most of it by that point, but wasn't that Quiz Super 7 they were shooting?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it was! I saw Airi and Shizuku where I was.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They spotted me and gave me some fan service♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? No fair! The others didn't notice me at all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They were midway through a shoot, so it's understandable really.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And they even replied to the message you sent them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Apparently you haven't replied to Ena about something.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um... Is she pretty mad at me?
